thread:
tara_csm: Hey team :wave: BayView (Finance) signed up for our sandbox seed. Need a quick enrollment + kickoff plan so we don't block their first week. TL;DR: 5 seats, want API quickstart, and a 60m kickoff next Tue. @maria_cs @ajay_eng can you take owner roles?

maria_cs: I can own enablement docs and the deck. Confirmed 5 seats. Sharing quickstart link: https://docs.redwood.com/early-engage/bayview-quickstart :link:

ajay_eng: I can own integration help and API keys. Recommend we give them a 100k token/day quota for the first 14 days and enable sandbox logging. I'll pre-provision keys for their org id.

sam_pm: I can join kickoff to set success metrics. Suggest a short feedback loop: 10-min post-kickoff survey + weekly 15-min check-ins x3. Can we add a Typeform quick survey? (I have a template).

lucy_ops: I'll create the account in Salesforce and tag as "early-engage". Renewal risk: set to monitor -> low for now but flag if usage < 2k tokens/day by week 2. I'll add task for health check cadence.

tara_csm: Thanks — action items: (1) maria create deck + upload by EOD Fri, (2) ajay provision keys + send instructions, (3) sam prepare survey, (4) lucy add SFDC record and schedule 3 check-ins.

ajay_eng: Quick note on provisioning: I'll attach a sample cURL snippet in the invite email so engineers can hit endpoints immediately:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \ 
  -d '{"org":"bayview","quota":"100000"}'
```

maria_cs: Deck draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/bayview-onboard-draft (comments welcome). Added a short walkthrough for embeddings and rate limits.

scheduler-bot: Meeting created: BayView Kickoff — Tue 10:00am PT, 60m. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/xyz :calendar:

tara_csm: Perfect. I'll send intro + meeting invite to their CSM. Sam — capture the survey link and I’ll include it in the meeting follow-up. Also please add one short NPS touch at week 3.

sam_pm: Will do. I'll use the standard 4-question survey and add a quick question about latency vs accuracy for their use case.

lucy_ops: SFDC record done + tasks assigned to owners. Tagging for onboarding tracker.

tara_csm: Great team — thanks. I'll post an update after kickoff with initial feedback. If anything blocks the deck or keys, ping here. :thumbsup:
